entries.title: Show HN: I built a tiny LLM to demystify how language models work
entries.author: armanified
entries.current_title: Show HN: I built a tiny LLM to demystify how language models work
entries.excerpt: Built a ~9M param LLM from scratch to understand how they actually work. Vanilla transformer, 60K synthetic conversations, ~130 lines of PyTorch. Trains in 5 min on a free Colab T4. The fish thinks the meaning of life is food. Fork it and swap the personality for your own character.
entries.guide_zh: 用约九百万参数、百余行 PyTorch 从零训练小语言模型，帮助理解其工作方式。

entries.title: Show HN: I built a frontpage for personal blogs
entries.author: ramkarthikk
entries.current_title: Show HN: I built a frontpage for personal blogs
entries.excerpt: With social media and now AI, its important to keep the indie web alive. There are many people who write frequently. Blogosphere tries to highlight them by fetching the recent posts from personal blogs across many categories. There are two versions: Minimal (HN-inspired, fast, static): https://text.blogosphere.app/ Non-minimal: https://blogosphere.app/ If you don't find your blog (or your favorite ones), please add them. I will review and approve it.
entries.guide_zh: Blogosphere 汇集个人博客的新文章，为独立写作者建立发现首页。

entries.title: Show HN: boringBar – a taskbar-style dock replacement for macOS
entries.author: a-ve
entries.current_title: Show HN: boringBar – a taskbar-style dock replacement for macOS
entries.excerpt: Hi HN! I recently switched from a Fedora/GNOME laptop to a MacBook Air. My old setup served me well as a portable workstation, but I’ve started traveling more while working remotely and needed something with similar performance but better battery life. The main thing I missed was a simple taskbar that shows the windows in the current workspace instead of a Dock that mixes everything together. I built boringBar so I would not have to use the Dock. It shows only the windows in
entries.guide_zh: 从 GNOME 转到 Mac 后，作者制作任务栏风格 Dock 替代品 boringBar。

entries.title: Show HN: Pardonned.com – A searchable database of US Pardons
entries.author: vidluther
entries.current_title: Show HN: Pardonned.com – A searchable database of US Pardons
entries.excerpt: https://pardonned.com Inspired by the videos of Liz Oyer, I wanted to be able to verify her claims and just look up all the pardons more easily. Tech Stack: Playwright - to sccrape the DOJ website SQLite - local database Astro 6 - Build out a static website from the sqlite db All code is open source and available on Github.
entries.guide_zh: Pardonned.com 整理可搜索的美国赦免数据库，帮助查证视频里的说法。

entries.title: Show HN: Ghost Pepper – 100% local hold-to-talk speech-to-text for macOS
entries.author: MattHart88
entries.current_title: Show HN: Ghost Pepper – Local hold-to-talk speech-to-text for macOS
entries.excerpt: I built this because I wanted to see how far I could get with a voice-to-text app that used 100% local models so no data left my computer. I've been using a ton for coding and emails. Experimenting with using it as a voice interface for my other agents too. 100% open-source MIT license, would love feedback, PRs, and ideas on where to take it.
entries.guide_zh: Ghost Pepper 在 macOS 本地按住说话即可转写，开源且不上传语音数据。
